integrity: Analytic proof plus reproducible finite Fourier enumeration, exact congruence logic, direct spectral decomposition and finite-time numerical checks; finite checks do not establish infinite parameter coverage.
scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous nearest-neighbor one-excitation cycles, two positive point losses and coherent Peierls flux only. Prior one-trap dark-projection methods are acknowledged; novelty best-knowledge and general controllability theorem overlap remains a risk. No independent validation.
title: Arithmetic flux-switching of dark survival on a cycle with two absorbing vertices
